limitations: One matching repeat does not establish general repeatability, variance, identical trajectories or identical timing.
Sampled acceptance does not establish a continuous-time guarantee, realtime, superiority or a unique physical cause.
view.binding_resolution: Each executions row supplies execution/structure/scientific identities; facts[metric] selects the immutable fact ID and canonical value/unit. metric_sources resolve original sources. Full expanded ledger retained in archive.

scientific_question.current_question: Choose the next legal decision from updated bound feedback, including recorded matching repeats.
scientific_question.frozen_pre_experiment_question: Can design/control adaptation improve joint reach-and-hold under the five already frozen small initial-angle/rate variations around the retained successful nominal configuration? The unchanged incumbent's perturbed performance is not established by failures of changed near-section-scale candidates. Choose affordable mathematical search, applicable retained diagnosis, justified references/repetitions or STOP from complete relevant evidence. No predetermined winning point or required structural edit.

policy.computation: Reported separately; never substitutes for reach or holding acceptance.
policy.objective: Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked.
policy.rule: Joint acceptance first; otherwise componentwise physical comparison.
policy.tradeoff: Any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement.

coverage.definition: Both endpoints, timestamps aligned to task sample_period_s; missing samples are unavailable, never a pass.

duration.definition: Final closed interval [task duration - window, task duration].

position.definition: Maximum sampled world tip position error in the final interval.

speed.definition: Maximum sampled world tip translational speed norm in the final interval.
Euclidean norm of tip-site translational Jacobian times recorded backend qvel, reconstructed with sealed robot.xml and qpos; no finite differencing

terminal.definition: Euclidean world tip position error at the final execution sample; sealed evaluate.reach is the outcome authority.
